# M1-S6: eject a loGo/s module using ?, defer?, and errdefer to pure Go.
# main.lgo exercises all three M1 error forms plus a doc comment and
# interior comments; the module depends on a second loGo/s module via a
# local replace. The ejected tree must run under plain go with identical
# output, keep every comment verbatim, and stay vet- and gofmt-clean.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

# logos runs the module before eject.
logos run .
stdout '^loaded logos$'
stdout '^hello logos$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it (#112).
mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod
cp ../dep/go.mod $WORK/orig/dep-go.mod
cp ../dep/greet/greet.lgo $WORK/orig/greet.lgo

# Eject the main module.
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/greet/greet.go

# Ejected files take plain .go names and carry no logos build tag (#112).
exec find out -name '*.gen.go'
! stdout .
! grep '^//go:build !logos' out/main.go
! grep '^//go:build !logos' out/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/greet/greet.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with identical output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..

# Every original comment survives verbatim in out/main.go (A7 text-level oracle).
grep 'Command ejectdemo' out/main.go
grep 'load cleans the input' out/main.go
grep 'Validate the raw input' out/main.go
grep 'raw input value' out/main.go
grep 'propagate cleaning errors' out/main.go
grep 'flush state' out/main.go
grep 'join cleanup errors' out/main.go
grep 'undo partial work' out/main.go
grep 'runs on error only' out/main.go

# The ejected tree is vet- and gofmt-clean.
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

# out/go.mod keeps require and replace lines for the loGo/s dependency
# and for the ejected support module; the support module declares itself.
grep -count=3 'example\.com/dep' out/go.mod
grep -count=2 'gosuda/loGos/rt' out/go.mod
grep 'module github\.com/gosuda/loGos/rt' out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod

# A second eject into the non-empty directory fails.
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'logos eject: out: directory is not empty'

# logos build --emit-go produces the same tree as logos eject.
logos build --emit-go=out2
logos eject -o out2b
cmp out2/main.go out2b/main.go
cmp out2/go.mod out2b/go.mod
cmp out2/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod out2b/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
cmp out2/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/go.mod out2b/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/go.mod
cmp out2/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/greet/greet.go out2b/_logos_deps/example.com/dep@v0.0.0/greet/greet.go

# The source tree is unchanged after both ejects (#112).
cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod
cmp ../dep/go.mod $WORK/orig/dep-go.mod
cmp ../dep/greet/greet.lgo $WORK/orig/greet.lgo

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/eject

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep v0.0.0 => ../dep

-- m/main.lgo --
// Command ejectdemo exercises eject over ?, defer?, and errdefer.
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep/greet"
)

// load cleans the input and reports each step.
func load(s string) (string, error) {
	// Validate the raw input before greeting.
	name := greet.Clean(
		s, // raw input value
	)? // propagate cleaning errors
	defer greet.Close(/* flush state */)? // join cleanup errors
	errdefer greet.Rollback(/* undo partial work */) // runs on error only
	fmt.Println("loaded", name)
	return name, nil
}

func main() {
	name, err := load("  logos  ")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("hello", name)
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- dep/greet/greet.lgo --
// Package greet helps the eject test with a local loGo/s dependency.
package greet

import "strings"

// Clean trims surrounding spaces from s.
func Clean(s string) (string, error) {
	return strings.TrimSpace(s), nil
}

// Close flushes greet state.
func Close() error {
	return nil
}

// Rollback undoes partial greet work.
func Rollback() {
}
